frame.question: Why is my profit down this week?

cash_gaps.title: Transfers recorded at the till never reached the bank

evidence.sql:
SELECT ROUND(-COALESCE(SUM(net_ngn), 0), 2) AS effect_ngn FROM becuz.transfer_check
WHERE bank_txn_id IS NULL AND CAST(sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
evidence.summary: Transfers recorded at the till never reached the bank: -33,100

check.note: The re-check matched: 33,100 naira from 6 records. 6 records back this.

falsified_by.test: every transfer sale this week has a matching bank credit

summary.what_happened: Profit this week was ₦396,172, which is ₦6,562 more than a usual week (₦389,610).
why: Profit went up, and none of the problems Becuz checks for showed up this week.
cash: ₦33,100 from 6 transfer sales was recorded at the till but never reached the bank. The sales still count toward your profit, but this money is missing from your account.

what_to_do.action: Check these transfers against the bank app with the staff who recorded them.

owner_questions.question: 6 transfer sales this week have no matching payment in the bank (SL-03208, SL-03231, SL-03302, SL-03323, SL-03333, SL-03372). Can you check them with the staff who recorded them?

limitations: Findings show correlation, not proven causation.
Sample mode: evidence ratings come from fixed rules, not a model; every number comes from SQL.
